name: usepilot
description: Pilot: take the controls from your coding agent. A control surface for coding agents, with checked results: edit, comment on and ask for tasks on your running app, and Pilot checks what the agent changed on the page.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pilot/overlay build && pnpm --filter @pilot/cli build && node build.mjs
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build && node build.mjs license
